official_metrics.historical_adjusted_score: exact formula undisclosed in examined records; not reproducible
official_metrics.opponent_weighted_tiebreak: sum(outcome_point * opponent_point_rate) / N; separate from historical adjusted score

comparison_order: submission identity and match coverage validation
raw WDL/points/error rates and contemporaneous opponent strength description
round-specific strength-stratum overlap standardization if full leaderboard exists
optional regularized match-graph model only with complete connected fixtures and explicit identifiability checks
target: current whole-pool format in registered input-side conditions; not obsolete opposite-school-only format
exclude_from_causal_claims: our candidate and calendar period fully confounded
all-team percentile from selectively retained rows
sensitivity: leave-our-match-out opponent score where exactly reconstructible
same opponent team versus same verified opponent version
uncertainty: cluster common-opponent comparisons; retain repeated maps in a block; report tiny effective samples directly; no winner inflation from many submissions
new_data_needed: all own match IDs and submission IDs
full latest leaderboard and per-round if accessible
exact current column labels/help text/round inclusion
submission upload identity and ZIP/source hashes where obtainable
forfeit/error details and actual engine input side
